hasSlicers: This table has slicers. Delete them before hiding the header row.
needsData: A table needs at least one row of data to hide its header row.
needsHeader: Turn on the Header Row to use filter buttons.
noRoom: There is no room above the table for its header row.
rowAboveProtected: The row above the table is protected.
unprotect: Unprotect the sheet to change the table.
